justification: For each positive epsilon, the event that the maximum exceeds epsilon is the union of the K events {|X_{n,j}| > epsilon}, so the bound in lines 14-16 is valid without any independence assumption. Each probability on the right tends to zero by the stated coordinatewise convergence in probability, and the fixed finite value of K makes their sum tend to zero. Lines 19-20 therefore give exactly the stated convergence in probability.
